normalization_note: Nonlinear signaling costs equal the default affine signaling term at the pooled median V1 firing rate. Because V1 inference also partials firing rate, stability across deterministic monotone costs is a denominator sensitivity check, not independent metabolic validation.
network_scope_note: The recurrent metric is the 20-ms held-out population decoder's Fano information lower bound per cost. It is analyzed separately from the single-neuron matched-word Direct-Method quantity and is not placed on the calibrated Fig. 5 reference curve.
R0_scope_note: R0 does not enter the empirical I/C ratios tested here. It only rescales the anchored analytic reference in Fig. 5; the independent min/median/max anchor scan is reported in Fig. S7.
